name: 拼多多完善商品信息：字段填全（goods_add 页，状态等待）

nodes.label: 触发平台草稿恢复（会跳回 goods_add）
前置：确认在 goods_add 页 + 关掉残留浮层

args.code: () => { if (location.href.indexOf('goods_add') < 0) { throw new Error('当前不是 goods_add 页: ' + location.href.slice(0,80)); } document.body.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true })); return 'ok ' + location.href.slice(0,70); }

nodes.label: 给所有目标控件打稳定标记

args.code: () => { const brand = document.querySelector('input[placeholder*="品牌名称"]'); if (brand) brand.setAttribute('data-rpa-brand','1'); const wrap = [...document.querySelectorAll('[class*=TB_tableWrapper]')].find(w => (w.innerText||'').indexOf('*库存') >= 0); const row = wrap && [...wrap.querySelectorAll('tr,[class*=tr]')].find(r => r.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder="请输入"]').length >= 3); if (row) { [...row.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder="请输入"]')].forEach((e,i) => e.setAttribute('data-rpa-sku', String(i))); } const ref = document.querySelector('input[placeholder*="应大于商品最大单买价"]'); if (ref) ref.setAttribute('data-rpa-ref','1'); const disc = document.querySelector('input[placeholder*="5.0~9.9"]'); if (disc) disc.setAttribute('data-rpa-disc','1'); [...document.querySelectorAll('input[type=file]')].forEach((e,i) => e.setAttribute('data-rpa-file', String(i))); return { brand: !!brand, sku: row ? row.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder="请输入"]').length : 0, files: document.querySelectorAll('input[type=file]').length }; }

nodes.label: 批量填所有「请选择」下拉（各选第一项）

args.code: async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const out = []; for (let round = 0; round < 8; round++) { const empties = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder="请选择"]')].filter(e => !(e.value||'').trim()); if (!empties.length) break; const inp = empties[0]; inp.click(); await sleep(500); const ul = document.querySelector('ul[class*=dropdownPanel]'); const first = ul ? ul.querySelector('li[class*=cIL_item]') : null; if (!first) { inp.setAttribute('data-rpa-noopt','1'); break; } const pick = (first.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,14); first.click(); await sleep(400); out.push(pick); document.body.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(200); } return { 选中: out }; }

nodes.label: SKU 单买价（必须比拼单价高1元）
商品参考价（应大于最大单买价）
重定位详情图 file input（不依赖旧标记）

args.code: () => { const files = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[type=file]')]; const detail = files.find(e => { let p = e.parentElement, t = ''; for (let k = 0; k < 5 && p; k++) { t += (p.innerText||'') + ' '; p = p.parentElement; } return t.indexOf('50张') >= 0 || t.indexOf('快捷编辑') >= 0; }); if (detail) detail.setAttribute('data-rpa-detail','1'); return { 找到: !!detail, 文件框数: files.length }; }

nodes.label: 勾售后（7天无理由 / 假一赔十）

args.code: () => { const out = []; [...document.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]')].forEach((c,i) => { if (!c.checked) { c.click(); out.push(i); } }); return { 已勾: out }; }

nodes.label: 末尾断言：错误0 + 字段清单

args.code: async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const t = document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '); const err = (t.match(/错误（(\d+)）/)||[])[1]; const rate = (t.match(/填写率\s*(\d+)%/)||[])[1]; const sku = [0,1,2,3,4].map(k => { const e = document.querySelector('[data-rpa-sku="'+k+'"]'); return e ? e.value : ''; }); if (err === '0' && sku.every(v => v)) { return { 错误: err, 属性填写率: rate, SKU: sku, 轮播图: (t.match(/已上传(\d+)\/10张/)||[])[1], 详情图: (t.match(/已上传(\d+)\/50张/)||[])[1], 品牌: (document.querySelector('input[placeholder*="品牌名称"]')||{}).value || '(平台品牌库，无匹配)' }; } await sleep(300); } throw new Error('状态未达标: ' + document.body.innerText.slice(0,180)); }
